Keep product companion, single-player mod, multiplayer server, creator marketplace and fan media use-cases distinct; for each verify exact game/platform, permitted channel, written voice/likeness/assets rights and non-endorsement.

Do not release or market an experience dependent on GTA VI mod/creator service until the exact Rockstar/platform permission, Covered Game scope and technical support are verified; test claim comprehension for “inspired by” versus compatibility.

Keep in-product/media playback, original score, promotional singles, standalone album, physical variants and sample previews as separate catalog types; attach source/rightsholder, license territory/term and exact playback/download channel.
Label selected sample versus complete catalogue and retain the last-verified date; do not infer external playback/streaming rights from a product bundle or album purchase.
Reuse existing Avocado catalog contracts to distinguish creator-declared targets, loader-blocking prerequisites, independently validated host/version, and upcoming deprecation/removal dates.
Before execution, report unsatisfied mandatory dependencies and state what was actually tested; treat metadata and signatures as claims/identity rather than safety approval.

Cross-check existing Broker and Wallet contracts: client/agent/UI output is a proposal; rebind authenticated principal and action policy server-side, validate scope/value/target, and use idempotency/replay guards before recording success.
Keep GTA Online/FiveM points outside real-money RQ13 Wallet authority; no conversion or bridging.

Before any game client, remote-play, screen/data capture, account-linking or automated action integration, inventory endpoint/execution location/data/owner/platform rule and express authorization; otherwise keep Avocado product non-connected.
Describe RockstarOS/Sky cloud LLM use separately from remote execution/streaming or automation of a Rockstar Service; route ambiguous game integration for legal/security review.

Before any authorized game-adjacent business hypothesis, screen for prohibited or unsupported real-money wagering/lootbox/gacha, game-currency cash sale, crypto/NFT, third-party promotion, or paid access to Rockstar-owned game content; preserve disabled RQ13 and separate Wallet.
If directory uses creator popularity/social proof, state what and when was measured and separate it from item-level safety, rights review, compatibility and outcome quality.

In a future approved fixture study, test whether participants confuse creator popularity with exact-item evidence and whether popularity/paid visibility biases choice toward or away from user-matched verified items.

If a separately approved Avocado creator/Tool community exists, treat community discussions/templates/tutorials as moderation surfaces separate from published packages; test scoped policy guidance, reporting/escalation and appeal.
Measure legitimate creator question completion, harmful exposure, report resolution, incorrect removals and repeat violations; never infer the need for a forum from Roblox community research.

For a future approved Avocado pilot, compare returning/high-activity contributors with invited, quiet and non-responding target users; tag device, region, role and experience; publish response/attrition denominators.
Separate actionable bug/safety/accessibility reports from preference votes; use community feedback as one evidence stream, not a market-wide demand estimate.
For a future approved RQ14 study, predefine participant fit, minimal data capture, retention/deletion, interpretation owner and triage; measure recruitment yield, missing-data rate and analysis time.

For authorized assistant UX, distinguish verified facts, sourced claims, model inference and unknown state; attach source/date, offer correction/verification, and test calibration rather than assuming disclosure alone suffices.

Test AI role/capability disclosure by user expertise and action scope; ask whether users can predict actual permissions and detect incorrect suggestions, not merely notice an AI label or report higher trust.

For any approved cross-device accessibility preference, consider optional feature-level choices rather than diagnosis labels, with scope/review/delete and local override; label author description, exact tested behavior and user report separately.

Avocado already has a `rock-game-sdk-diagnostic/1` sandbox example; only if an approved Tool task exposes a concrete gap, compare its current fixture/task contract with reproducible environment/version evidence, bounded consented diagnostics and existing report states. Measure reproducibility/resolution rather than report volume; do not add or replace a schema on analogy alone.

If studying Avocado agent trust, measure actual scope compliance, recoverability and verified outcomes beside trust/return intent; never substitute benevolent persona cues for permission or Broker checks.
AvocadoMini use-case #995 already requires a public interface and permission before any game bridge; the GTA VI research reinforces this gate without editing the idea or granting a right.
If Rockstar later publishes a GTA VI interface, re-evaluate its exact title/platform/build, license, data, actions, consent and support contract before proposing an adapter.

For existing RQ14 publish/review workflow, check submitted, reviewed, published and changed-after-review revisions remain distinct; stale approval must not carry over after an edit, and rollback/withdrawal/appeal need their own states and owner. Reuse lib/workflow.ts and fixtures if a real gap is demonstrated.

For media/product catalogs, distinguish promotional appearance, in-game preview, standalone track/album, full playback asset, rights/license, platform, territory/term and purchasable offer; a preview or promotion is not permission to host or retransmit.

Edited launch-film narrative places the central character relationship and music before action cuts; treat this as creative inspiration only. For any Avocado demo, pair user outcome with visible verifiable status, permission, cost and recovery details, and test task comprehension separately from views/affect.
